dialogues.speaker: Farabi
dialogues.text: Hmm... Something's bothering me. Does such a creature really exist?

dialogues.speaker: Farabi
dialogues.text: Sorry, I was just thinking about something. Mr. Edmund told me today that he once found huge animal prints at the base of Dragonspine.

dialogues.speaker: Farabi
dialogues.text: Based on the descriptions, they seem like the prints of a Snowboar. But can there really be a Snowboar that big?

dialogues.speaker: Farabi
dialogues.text: Once we determine the route the Snowboars took, the next stage would be to go to Dragonspine to investigate their survival out in the wild. Let's keep an eye out for the huge prints then as well.
